integrity: Analytical proof and reproducible finite checks supplied; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Does not apply to multigraphs, unequal valuations, or relevant-good-only fairness.
Analytical count holds for all n>=3; exhaustive direct checker covers n=3..14.
Unindexed equivalent counting work cannot be ruled out.
scientific_scope: Unit-weight additive valuations on simple labeled cycles of at least three vertices; every edge assigned to an endpoint; all-good EFX includes zero-valued deleted goods.
title: A Lucas–six-period census of all-good EFX orientations on unit cycles
